The files in this folder are data of the Autonomous Province of Bolzano -
South Tyrol, measured by the stations of its Agency for Civil Protection
(Agentur für Bevölkerungsschutz) and published as the dataset "Webservice
der meteorologischen und hydrographischen Messungen",
https://data.civis.bz.it/de/dataset/misure-meteo-e-idrografiche, under
Creative Commons CC0 1.0,
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.de. The province's
documentation of the service calls the values raw data that have not been
validated. They are not covered by the licence of the code around them.

They were recorded on 2026-11-21 from
https://geoservices.buergernetz.bz.it/services/meteo/v1/, without a key,
with curl.

stations.json and sensors.json are the whole answers to the adapter's two
requests, unchanged, both asked at 10:36:37 UTC:

    stations.json   GET /stations   94,632 bytes: 230 stations, of which 97
                                    measure weather and 133 water
    sensors.json    GET /sensors    184,034 bytes: 993 rows, the newest
                                    value of every sensor of every station

The newest values in sensors.json are of 11:20 local time, 10:20 UTC, and
so were 17 minutes old. The answer was asked for twice before, at 10:30:48
and 10:31:58 UTC; the newest values were then of 10:10 and of 10:20 UTC.
stations.json ends its lines with CR LF, as the service sent it.

The folder evening/ holds fifteen answers of the service's third part, the
time series, whole and unchanged, asked between 10:36:38 and 10:36:46 UTC:

    evening/STATION_SENSOR.json   GET /timeseries?station_code=STATION
                                  &sensor_code=SENSOR&date_from=202611181900
                                  &date_to=202611182010

for the stations 37100MS (Sterzing), 35100WS (Jaufenkamm) and 83200MS
(Bozen) and the sensors WG, WG.BOE, WR, LT and LF: what each measured
between 19:00 and 20:10 local time on 2026-11-18, eight values each. The
adapter does not ask for time series. They are here for the next two files.

stations_evening.json and sensors_evening.json are NOT answers of the
service as it gave them. They are a sample for the server's development
mode, whose clock stands at 19:05 UTC on 2026-11-18, three days before
this source was recorded; the service answers with the newest values only
and cannot be asked for an earlier moment.

    stations_evening.json   stations.json cut down to the three stations
                            above, each byte for byte as the service
                            wrote it, between the first ten lines and the
                            last two of the answer
    sensors_evening.json    the fifteen rows of sensors.json for those
                            three stations and five sensors, in the
                            answer's form, each with its "DATE" and
                            "VALUE" replaced by the entry of
                            evening/STATION_SENSOR.json for
                            2026-11-18T19:50:00CET

So every value in the sample is one the service gave, for the station, the
sensor and the moment the sample says: 18:50 UTC on 2026-11-18, which is
fifteen minutes before the development mode's clock. What the service
answered at that moment is not known. A test of this crate holds every
row of the sample against the time series.

sensors_damaged.json is not the service's data: it is sensors_evening.json
with seven rows changed by hand, to test how the adapter reports what it
cannot read. The test that uses it says what was changed.

To record them again: fetch /stations and /sensors in one go and replace
the two files; set the moment in tests/pipeline.rs; run the tests with
VENTI_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 and review what changed. The counts the test pins
(stations, anemometers with a value, what validation removed) are of that
moment and will differ. The evening sample stays as it is for as long as
the development mode's clock does; should the clock move, make the sample
again for the new moment from time series asked for it, as above. The
service keeps them: the ones here were asked three days after the evening
they are of.

A value in these files is what an instrument reported. It is no statement
that a place can be flown.
